name: timestamp_decode
description: Take a number out of an artefact and say what date it could be under every epoch in common forensic use — Unix, FILETIME, Apple, WebKit, HFS+, DOS, OLE and more — with the plausible readings ranked. For when a field holds a number and nothing says which clock it came from.

value.description: The number, in decimal or as 0x hex

plausible_only.description: Return only readings that land between 1990 and twenty years from now (default true)

hex.description: Treat a bare value as hexadecimal
